subject.title: fix: before_agent_run transform no longer leaks redacted text into history

question: Should `before_agent_run` become a public transform API whose replacement permanently becomes the canonical stored user turn?
rationale: Current main exposes only pass/block, while this PR adds a plugin API and deliberately replaces user-submitted transcript content; implementation correctness cannot decide that permanent audit and compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve canonical redaction
options.body: Adopt transformed text as the model-visible and canonical persisted turn after the delimiter defect, compatibility coverage, and live proof are complete.

options.title: Separate persistence control
options.body: Keep transforms model-bound by default and design a distinct explicit outcome or API for plugins authorized to replace canonical transcript content.

options.title: Decline transform API
options.body: Retain the existing pass/block gate and require redaction plugins to block sensitive turns rather than rewrite them.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical redaction
recommendation.body: Adopt transformed text as the model-visible and canonical persisted turn after the delimiter defect, compatibility coverage, and live proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans core transcript semantics, agent runtime behavior, and the public plugin contract rather than only the CLI implementation.
